source_rules.523煤矿焦煤库存: Only from the corrected master npz / MS Excel mine clean-stock and raw-stock fields; formula = clean_stock + raw_stock*0.38. Never overwrite from screenshots or sheet4_manual_overrides_long.csv.
source_rules.523家矿企煤周度总产量（折算）: Only from MS Excel mine clean-output and raw-output fields; formula = (clean_output + raw_output*0.38)*7.
source_rules.314家洗煤厂精煤库存: Only from online MS Excel clean-coal inventory field, not the offline/screenshot 314 sample.
source_rules.sheet4_manual_overrides_long.csv: Allowed for MS三大口岸、沿海港口等明确手工补点；forbidden for 523 and 314 master series.
source_rules.date_alignment: If source collection date differs from the report week date, keep source_date in upstream summary/catalog and use report_date for dashboard periods.
